purpose: Compute the first baseline reduced-H3 directional second-order particular state Z20 on the frozen GE15/GE18 first-order reference, with a fixed window-retarded zero-homogeneous convention and explicit matter-reduction/systematic boundaries.
target_equation: L_total Z20 = -Q_total(Z10,Z10) - 2 Y2[Z10], with L_total=L_Einstein+AeST+L_dust and Q_total=Q_Einstein+AeST+Q_dust.

scope.physical_interpretation: formal epsilon->0 directional second-order coefficient only
scope.reason: NL1C0 already established that the actual primordial-amplitude retained band is high-gradient; GE19 therefore does not evaluate the deep-MOND directional coefficient as a finite-amplitude nonlinear prediction.

frozen_first_order_direction.amplitude: sqrt(2 w_i P_R(k_i)) with the frozen GE04/NL1C4 logarithmic trapezoid weights and P_R=A_s(k/k_pivot)^(n_s-1)
frozen_first_order_direction.metric_AeST_source: GE15 R1 cancellation-free dense trace/local jet

external_full_standard_first_order_syste.treatment: reported separately; not represented by the C_min/C_max envelope and not converted into a fake off-shell dust solve

Y2.implementation: real-space flux with exact FFT spatial derivatives and 2/3 flux dealiasing

gauge_and_fields.representation: plane-symmetric scalar Newtonian gauge on the second-order directional coefficient

window_retarded_particular_convention.interpretation: This fixes one window-local particular Green-function solution. Earlier-time/primordial second-order history appears inside the omitted homogeneous solution and remains uncertified.

discretization.time_derivative: fourth-order finite-difference matrix in ln(a), converted by d/dt=H d/dln(a)
discretization.solved_fourier_modes: m=1..40; m=0 is reported as an unsolved background/backreaction source and excluded from the particular structure-state solve
discretization.linear_solve: square collocation system; replace the first two rows of each dynamical-field equation by the frozen value/derivative initial conditions; scipy sparse direct solve

descriptive_outputs: per beta0 and C: Fourier Z20 particular coefficients m=1..40 across 64 ln(a) nodes
source decomposition into analytic Einstein+AeST Q, dust Q, and Y2
m=0 source trajectory reported but not solved
ratio of Y2 source norm to analytic+dust quadratic source norm
anti_tuning: No gate, beta0, C value, phase, Fourier-mode range, time/spatial resolution, gauge condition, boundary convention or source normalization may be changed after inspecting GE19 output.
claim_boundary: A PASS certifies one reduced-matter, window-retarded particular directional Z20 solution. It does not certify the primordial/homogeneous second-order mode, a full-species Z20, finite eta, a physical-amplitude nonlinear evolution, collapse, halo physics, lensing or an observational signal.
